description: This file generates C# classes for .NET based on protocol definitions from a YAML file, including mapping types and properties, and writing class files with appropriate inheritance and serialization attributes.

methods.name: raise
methods.description: Throws an error for invalid items during processing.

methods.name: titleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case (first letter uppercase).

methods.name: mapType
methods.description: Maps protocol types to C# types.

methods.name: nullableSuffix
methods.description: Returns '?' if the type is nullable in C#.

methods.name: inlineType
methods.description: Converts protocol type definitions into C# type representations, handling arrays, enums, objects, and primitives.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Generates property definitions and schemes for a given set of properties.

methods.name: objectType
methods.description: Creates a C# class or object type representation from properties.

methods.name: writeCSharpClass
methods.description: Writes a C# class file with the specified class name, inheritance, and serialized properties.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes content to a specified file path.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case.

methods.name: processCustomType
methods.description: Processes custom protocol types into specific C# types based on properties.
